picks.file: Bristol, 1946 showing bomb damage on bottom right of image.png
picks.why: general aerial view of the center and the Floating Harbour; bomb damage only in one corner

gaps: P0: no candidates; P2: only Francis Place’s 1678 pencil panorama (#9), too faint to read
notes: Clifton Suspension Bridge photochroms (#17, #19) are the alternative for P4 if a landmark is preferred over a city scene. #29 is a general aerial; marked event false since the Blitz damage is minor in the frame. #15 (1831 riots) skipped as an event view. #35 is a 1973 aerial (upload date 2018), usable if a black-and-white P6 is wanted.
